text: Naafiqiiɓe ɓen hino huli nde Alla Jippinta e Nulaaɗo Makko on cortewol ƴellintinayngol gomɗimɓe ɓen kon ko ɓe suuɗi e ɓerɗe maɓɓe immorde e keeferaku. Maaku an Nulaaɗo : "Onon neefige en, luttee e jalkitugol yuwa diina kan. Alla ko yaltiniroowo kon ko huluɗon fii mun Jippinirgol cortewol maa humpitirgol ɗum Nulaaɗo Makko on".
